title: Nirmal Purja’s body recovered: How the Broad Peak avalanche wiped out Nepal’s best climbers - India Sentinels
description: Nirmal Purja’s body recovered: How the Broad Peak avalanche wiped out Nepal’s best climbers  India Sentinels
publisher.title: India Sentinels
full_article:
Nirmal Sherpa with SBS flag after conquering a summit.

New Delhi: The body of Nirmal Purja, the Nepali mountaineer known globally as “Nimsdai”, was recovered on Broad Peak on Sunday, days after an avalanche tore through his 10-member expedition on the Karakoram giant and buried the entire team. A ground rescue team of the Alpine Club of Pakistan (ACP) located him at approximately 5,700 metres, alongside three more bodies lying close by, taking the number of team members accounted for since the disaster to eight.

The avalanche struck Broad Peak’s standard West Ridge route, at an altitude of between 21,600 and 21,850 feet, on the morning of July 30. It killed not only Purja, one of the sport’s most decorated record-breakers, but five of Nepal’s most accomplished high-altitude guides – men whose collective résumés included dozens of Everest summits, a historic winter ascent of K2 and, in one case, all 14 of the world’s 8,000-metre peaks.

Nepal’s mountaineering industry has described it as one of the heaviest single losses its climbing fraternity has ever endured – not merely 10 lives lost on a mountainside, but decades of accumulated technical expertise erased in a single avalanche.

Recovery hampered by weather, terrain

Purja’s expedition, organized by Elite Exped, the company he co-founded, comprised six Nepalis including himself, and one climber each from Pakistan, Oman, the United States and China. The bodies of the Omani mountaineer, Nadhira Ahmed Abdullah Al Harthy, and the Nepali guide Pur Bahadur Gurung were the first brought down, on July 31, 2026, along with remains believed to be those of the American climber, Sarah Mallory Geis.

By Saturday, Elite Exped had confirmed that none of the 10 had survived. The body of the Nepali guide Gyaljen Sherpa was recovered the same day, and aerial reconnaissance spotted five more bodies scattered across the slope.

An eight-member ACP ground team, drawn from Pakistan and Nepal, reached Camp 1 before 9am on Sunday to continue the search. Helicopters could not be deployed because of poor weather, forcing rescuers to negotiate crevasses and unstable snowpack almost entirely on foot.

Pakistani rescuers have so far recovered the bodies of three of the 10 climbers swept away. One body, spotted at a considerably higher elevation, is unlikely to be recovered at all given how hazardous the terrain has become.

Broad Peak rises 8,051 metres in the Karakoram range of Gilgit-Baltistan, in Pakistan-occupied Kashmir, close to K2 and a short distance from the Chinese border. It is the world’s 12th-highest mountain and, though it lacks the notoriety of Everest or K2, remains a technically demanding climb that has claimed lives regularly since an Austrian team first summited it in 1957.

Elite commando who became world’s fastest climber

Purja, 43, was born on July 25, 1983, in Myagdi, in Nepal’s Gandaki province, into a family with a long tradition of Gurkha service. He joined the British Army’s Brigade of Gurkhas in 2003 and, six years on, became the first Gurkha accepted into the Special Boat Service, the Royal Navy’s elite special forces unit, where he served as a cold-weather warfare specialist.

He was also the first Gurkha to summit Everest while still in uniform, and in 2016 abandoned his own summit bid to rescue a stranded climber from the death zone.

After leaving the army, Purja set out to climb all 14 of the world’s 8,000-metre peaks faster than anyone before him, achieving the feat in six months and six days in 2019 – a record later chronicled in the Netflix documentary “14 Peaks: Nothing Is Impossible” and broken only in 2023.

He was awarded an MBE by the late queen, Elizabeth II, in 2018, and in January 2021 led an all-Nepali team to the first winter ascent of K2. He had recently written online that he was close to becoming the first person to climb all 14 “super peaks” twice without supplemental oxygen.

The prime minister of Nepal, Balendra Shah, said the climbers’ courage and dedication would continue to inspire long after their journeys were cut short. The prince of Wales, William, said he was saddened by the loss of a man who had served with distinction before becoming one of the world’s greatest mountaineers, crediting him with putting Nepalese climbers on the map.

The British climber Kenton Cool, who has summited Everest more times than any non-Sherpa alive, said Purja’s real legacy lay in how he transformed high-altitude guiding as an industry.

Nepali superclimbers killed alongside Purja

Alongside Purja, the avalanche killed Pur Bahadur Gurung (“Yukta”), Kili Pemba Sherpa (“Kilu”), Nima Sherpa, Nawang Thendu Sherpa and Gyaljen Sherpa (“Gyalu”). Kili Pemba’s death carries particular poignancy: barely a month earlier, on July 3, 2026, he had summited Nanga Parbat to complete all 14 8,000-metre peaks, having also been part of Purja’s 2021 winter K2 team.

Born in 1980 in Beding, in Dolakha’s Rolwaling valley, he began expedition work at 16, summited Everest 15 times, and guided disabled climbers, including a Chinese double amputee to Everest’s summit in 2018.

Gyalu Sherpa, who had worked with Seven Summit Treks for nearly eight years, held a Guinness World Record for summiting Kanchenjunga three times in one season. Yukta had climbed 12 of the 14 8,000-metre peaks and become the first member of the Gurung community to summit Everest 10 times.

Nima Sherpa had climbed four 8,000-metre peaks in 2026 alone, while Nawang Thendu, 29 and the youngest of the group, had summited Everest, Lhotse, Manaslu, Kanchenjunga, Makalu and Ama Dablam in barely four years of professional climbing.

The director of Seven Summit Treks, Chhang Dawa Sherpa, said an international-standard mountain guide cannot be produced overnight, and that companies spend years training climbers from remote Himalayan villages to reach world-class standard.

Nepal has lost individual legends before, industry figures said, but rarely so many at once, and never quite this abruptly.

एक शिखर जीतने के बाद एसबीएस के झंडा के साथ निर्मल शेरपा |

नई दिल्ली, मिथिला मिरर: काराकोरम दिग्गज कंपनी पर हुनकर 10 सदस्यीय अभियान के हिमस्खलन के किछुए दिन बाद रविदिन ब्रॉड पीक पर वैश्विक स्तर पर “निम्सदाई” के नाम सं जानल जाय वाला नेपाली पर्वतारोही निर्मल पुरजा के शव बरामद कायल गेल। अल्पाइन क्लब ऑफ पाकिस्तान (एसीपी) केरऽ एगो ग्राउंड रेस्क्यू टीम न॑ लगभग ५,७०० मीटर के दूरी प॑ हुनकऽ पता लगाय लेलकै, साथ ही साथ पास म॑ पड़लऽ तीन आरू शव भी, जेकरा स॑ आपदा के बाद टीम केरऽ सदस्यऽ के संख्या आठ होय गेलै ।

30 जुलाई के भोर में ब्रॉड पीक के मानक वेस्ट रिज मार्ग पर, जे 21,600 सं 21,850 फीट के बीच के ऊंचाई पर छल, हिमस्खलन सं 30 जुलाई के भोर में आयल छल.एहि सं एहि खेल के सब सं सजाओल गेल रिकॉर्ड तोड़य वाला पुरजा के त मारल गेल छल, बल्कि नेपाल के पांच सब सं कुशल उच्च ऊँचाई वाला गाइड के मौत भ गेल छल – एहन आदमी जिनकर सामूहिक रिज्यूमे में दर्जनों एवरेस्ट शामिल छल शिखर, के2 केरऽ ऐतिहासिक जाड़ा केरऽ चढ़ाई आरू एक मामला म॑ दुनिया केरऽ ८,००० मीटर केरऽ सब १४ चोटी ।

नेपाल केरऽ पर्वतारोहण उद्योग न॑ एकरा ओकरऽ पर्वतारोही भ्रातृत्व केरऽ सबस॑ भारी एकल नुकसान म॑ स॑ एक बतैन॑ छै – पहाड़ केरऽ ढाल प॑ महज १० लोगऽ के जान नै, बल्कि दशकऽ के संचित तकनीकी विशेषज्ञता एक ही हिमस्खलन म॑ मिटा देलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

मौसम, इलाका के कारण रिकवरी में बाधा

पुरजा केरऽ ई अभियान म॑ हुनकऽ सह-स्थापना वाला कंपनी एलिट एक्सपेड द्वारा आयोजित करलऽ गेलऽ छेलै, जेकरा म॑ हुनका सहित छह नेपाली आरू पाकिस्तान, ओमान, अमेरिका आरू चीन केरऽ एक-एक पर्वतारोही शामिल छेलै । ओमानी पर्वतारोही नाधीरा अहमद अब्दुल्लाह अल हार्टी आरू नेपाली गाइड पुर बहादुर गुरुंग केरऽ शव क॑ सबसें पहलऽ गिराय देलऽ गेलै, ३१ जुलाई २०२६ क॑, साथ ही साथ अमेरिकी पर्वतारोही सारा मैलोरी गेस केरऽ अवशेष भी मानलऽ जाय छै ।

शनिदिन तक एलिट एक्सपेड एहि बात क पुष्टि क चुकल छल जे 10 मे स कोनो गोटे नहि बचल अछि। नेपाली गाइड ग्यालजेन शेर्पा के शव ओही दिन बरामद भेल, आ हवाई टोही में पांच टा आओर लाश ढलान पर छिड़ियाएल देखल गेल.

पाकिस्तान आरू नेपाल स॑ चुनलऽ आठ सदस्यीय एसीपी केरऽ ग्राउंड टीम रविवार क॑ भोर ९ बजे स॑ पहल॑ कैंप १ पहुँची क॑ खोज जारी रखलकै । खराब मौसम के कारण हेलीकॉप्टर के तैनाती नै करलऽ जाब॑ सकलऽ छेलै, जेकरा चलतें बचावकर्ता सिनी क॑ लगभग पूरा तरह स॑ पैदल ही दरार आरू अस्थिर बर्फ के पैक के बातचीत करै ल॑ पड़लै ।

पाकिस्तानी बचावकर्मी एखन धरि बहरा गेल 10 पर्वतारोही मे सं तीन गोटे के लाश बरामद क चुकल अछि. काफी अधिक ऊंचाई पर देखल गेल एकटा लाश कए इ देखैत जे इ इलाका कतेक खतरनाक भ गेल अछि, ओकर बरामदगी क संभावना बिल्कुल कम अछि।

पाकिस्तान केरऽ कब्जा वाला कश्मीर केरऽ गिलगित-बाल्टिस्तान केरऽ काराकोरम श्रृंखला म॑ ब्रॉड पीक ८,०५१ मीटर ऊपर उठै छै, जे के२ के नजदीक आरू चीनी सीमा स॑ कुछ दूरी प॑ छै । ई दुनिया केरऽ 12वां सबस॑ ऊंचऽ पहाड़ छेकै आरू भले ही एकरा म॑ एवरेस्ट या के2 केरऽ बदनामी के कमी छै, लेकिन तकनीकी रूप स॑ ई एगो मांग वाला चढ़ाई बनलऽ छै जेकरा म॑ जब॑ स॑ १९५७ म॑ ऑस्ट्रिया केरऽ एगो टीम न॑ पहलऽ बार एकरऽ शिखर प॑ पहुँचलै, तब॑ स॑ नियमित रूप स॑ जान लेली जाय रहलऽ छै ।

कुलीन कमांडो जे दुनिया के सबस तेज पर्वतारोही बनलाह

43 वर्षीय पुर्जा के जन्म नेपाल के गण्डकी प्रांत के म्याग्डी में 25 जुलाई 1983 के गोर्खा सेवा के लंबा परंपरा वाला परिवार में भेल छल। 2003 म॑ ब्रिटिश सेना केरऽ ब्रिगेड आफ गोर्खा म॑ शामिल होय गेलै आरू छह साल बाद रॉयल नेवी केरऽ कुलीन विशेष बल इकाई स्पेशल बोट सर्विस म॑ स्वीकार करलऽ गेलऽ पहलऽ गोर्खा बनलै, जहां हुनी ठंड के मौसम म॑ युद्ध विशेषज्ञ के रूप म॑ काम करलकै ।

ओ पहिल गोर्खा सेहो छलाह जे वर्दी मे रहैत एवरेस्ट के शिखर पर पहुंचल छलाह, आओर 2016 मे फंसल पर्वतारोही के मौत के क्षेत्र सं बचाबय के अपन शिखर के कोशिश के छोड़ि देलखिन्ह.

सेना छोड़ला के बाद पुरजा न॑ दुनिया केरऽ सब 14 8,000 मीटर के चोटी प॑ अपनऽ पहलऽ के तुलना म॑ तेजी स॑ चढ़ै के काम शुरू करलकै, जेकरा स॑ ई कारनामा 2019 म॑ छह महीना आरू छह दिन म॑ हासिल करलकै – जेकरऽ रिकॉर्ड बाद म॑ नेटफ्लिक्स केरऽ डॉक्यूमेंट्री “14 पीक्स: नथिंग इज इम्पॉसिबल” म॑ वृत्तांत करलऽ गेलै आरू केवल 2023 म॑ ही टूटी गेलै ।

हुनका २०१८ म॑ स्वर्गीय रानी एलिजाबेथ द्वितीय द्वारा एमबीई स॑ सम्मानित करलऽ गेलऽ छेलै, आरू जनवरी २०२१ म॑ एक अखिल नेपाली टीम के नेतृत्व म॑ के२ केरऽ पहिलऽ शीतकालीन आरोहण म॑ पहुँचलै । हाल ही म॑ हुनी ऑनलाइन लिखन॑ छेलै कि बिना पूरक ऑक्सीजन के दू बार सब १४ “सुपर पीक” प॑ चढ़ै वाला पहलऽ व्यक्ति बन॑ के करीब छै ।

नेपालक प्रधानमन्त्री बलेन्द्र शाह कहलनि जे, यात्रा कटलाक बाद सेहो पर्वतारोहीक साहस आ समर्पण प्रेरणा दैत रहत। वेल्स केरऽ राजकुमार विलियम न॑ कहलकै कि दुनिया केरऽ सबसें बड़ऽ पर्वतारोही म॑ स॑ एक बनला स॑ पहल॑ विशिष्टता के साथ सेवा करै वाला एगो ऐसनऽ आदमी क॑ खोबै स॑ हुनका दुख छै, जेकरा म॑ हुनका नेपाली पर्वतारोही क॑ नक्शा प॑ उतारै के श्रेय देलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

ब्रिटिश पर्वतारोही केंटन कूल, जे जीवित कोनो गैर-शेर्पा स॑ भी अधिक बार एवरेस्ट के शिखर प॑ पहुँची चुकलऽ छै, न॑ कहलकै कि पुरजा केरऽ असली विरासत ई छै कि हुनी उच्च ऊंचाई प॑ गाइडिंग क॑ कोना एगो उद्योग के रूप म॑ बदली देलकै ।

पुरजा के बगल में नेपाली सुपरक्लाइम्बर मारल गेल

पुरजा के साथ-साथ हिमस्खलन में पुर बहादुर गुरुंग (“युक्ता”), किली पेम्बा शेर्पा (“किलू”), निमा शेर्पा, नवांग थेंदु शेर्पा आरू ग्यालजेन शेर्पा (“ग्यालू”) के मौत होय गेलै । किली पेम्बा केरऽ मौत म॑ विशेष मार्मिकता छै: मुश्किल स॑ एक महीना पहलें, ३ जुलाई, २०२६ क॑, हुनी नंगा पर्वत केरऽ शिखर प॑ पहुँची क॑ सब १४ ८,००० मीटर के चोटी क॑ पूरा करी चुकलऽ छेलै, जे पुरजा केरऽ २०२१ केरऽ शीतकालीन के२ टीम के हिस्सा भी छेलै ।

1980 म॑ डोलाखा केरऽ रोलवालिंग घाटी म॑ बेडिंग म॑ जन्मलऽ हुनी 16 साल के उम्र म॑ ही अभियान के काम शुरू करलकै, 15 बार एवरेस्ट केरऽ शिखर प॑ पहुँचलै, आरू 2018 म॑ एक चीनी डबल एम्प्यूटी सहित विकलांग पर्वतारोही सिनी क॑ एवरेस्ट केरऽ शिखर प॑ पहुँचै के मार्गदर्शन करलकै ।

लगभग आठ साल स॑ सेवन समिट ट्रेक्स के साथ काम करी चुकलऽ ग्यालू शेर्पा न॑ एक सीजन म॑ तीन बार कंचनजंगा के शिखर पर पहुँचै के गिनीज वर्ल्ड रिकॉर्ड बनैलकै । युक्ता 14 8000 मीटर के 12 चोटी पर चढ़ी गेल छल आ गुरुंग समुदाय के पहिल सदस्य बनल छल जे 10 बेर एवरेस्ट के शिखर पर पहुंचल छल।

नीमा शेर्पा न॑ असगरे २०२६ म॑ ८,००० मीटर के चार चोटी प॑ चढ़ी चुकलऽ छेलै, जबकि २९ वर्षीय आरू समूह केरऽ सबस॑ छोटऽ नवांग थेंडू न॑ मुश्किल स॑ चार साल के प्रोफेशनल क्लाइम्बिंग म॑ एवरेस्ट, ल्होत्से, मनसलू, कंचेनजुंगा, मकालू आरू आमा डब्लम केरऽ शिखर प॑ पहुँची गेलऽ छेलै ।

सेवन समिट ट्रेक्स के निदेशक छंग दवा शेर्पा नँ कहलकै कि अंतरराष्ट्रीय स्तर के माउंटेन गाइड रातों-रात नै बनैलौ जाब॑ सकै छै, आरू कंपनी सब सालौ तलक दूरस्थ हिमालयी गाँवऽ के पर्वतारोही सिनी क॑ विश्वस्तरीय स्तर प॑ पहुँचै लेली प्रशिक्षित करै छै ।

उद्योग जगत के आंकड़ा के कहनाय छनि जे नेपाल एहि सं पहिने व्यक्तिगत किंवदंती के गंवा चुकल अछि, मुदा एकहि बेर मे एतेक शायदे, आओर अचानक एतेक नहि.

full_article:
As rescuers recovered the body of climbing legend Nirmal Purja on Sunday, grief rippled hundreds of kilometres away in Nepal at the school where he first displayed the grit that would make him world-famous.

At the Small Heaven School in Chitwan district, friends, teachers and students gathered around a framed photograph of the 43-year-old British-Nepali climber, adorned with flowers.

Lighting candles, they shared with AFP their memories of the boy they knew long before he became one of the most celebrated figures in modern mountaineering.

"When he was missing, we were praying for him and spent sleepless nights," Dhiraj Bahadur Panta, a school friend of Purja, told AFP, his voice quivering with emotion.

"It was not only me and my friends. I think people all over the world who knew him... prayed for him. But it was his fate, no one could avoid it."

Purja was killed alongside nine other climbers after they were caught in a deadly avalanche on Pakistan's Broad Peak on Thursday.

News of his death has prompted heartfelt tributes from across the climbing community and beyond, with figures such as Britain's Prince William offering condolences.

Purja arrived at the boarding school in Nepal's southern plains as a young boy before later joining the British Gurkhas, a path that eventually led him into elite military service and then to global mountaineering stardom.

He studied at the school for eight years, forging a close bond with fellow students and teachers.

- 'Fearless' -

On Sunday, students filed past his portrait, laying flowers and offering prayers as teachers remembered their courageous and disciplined pupil.

"Even when he was in class three, he was fearless and committed to achieving something," Shailendra Baral, who supervised Purja in the school hostel, told AFP.

"He was honest and an obedient student, which made us happy. We found courage in him even when he was a child."

In 2019, Purja stunned the climbing fraternity by scaling the world's 14 highest peaks in just over six months, shattering the previous record of seven years.

His feat was later chronicled in a Netflix documentary, helping inspire a new generation of climbers and elevating Nepal's profile in a sport long dominated by Western adventurers.

In 2021, he was part of the historic all-Nepali team that completed the first winter ascent of K2, the world's second-highest mountain and one of mountaineering's most dangerous challenges.

In 2022, Purja received a hero's welcome when he came to Chitwan for the screening of his documentary.

"I grew up here, running around with no shoes on," he said in a social media post at the time.

"This is my hometown and so I wanted everyone here to see the film and inspire the younger generation."

For many of the students gathered on Sunday, Purja's achievements were already part of the school's folklore.

"It really feels bad to hear this news because we had always (heard) good things about him," said student Sarbagya Paudel.

"His bravery has set a great example for our school. Not only has he made our school proud, but he has also brought pride to Nepal.

"It is heartbreaking to know that he is no longer with us."

पूर्वा नेपाल केरऽ दक्षिणी मैदान केरऽ बोर्डिंग स्कूल म॑ एगो छोटऽ लड़का के रूप म॑ पहुँचलै आरू बाद म॑ ब्रिटिश गोर्खा म॑ शामिल होय गेलै, जेकरा स॑ अंततः हुनका कुलीन सैन्य सेवा म॑ आरू फेरू वैश्विक पर्वतारोहण स्टारडम म॑ प्रवेश करलकै ।

स्कूल हॉस्टल मे पुर्जा क देखरेख करनिहार शैलेन्द्र बराल एएफपी स कहलथि जे जखन ओ क्लास थ्री मे छलाह तखनो ओ निर्भीक छलाह आ किछु हासिल करबा लेल प्रतिबद्ध छलाह।

2019 म॑ पुरजा न॑ छह महीना स॑ कुछ अधिक समय म॑ दुनिया केरऽ 14 सबसें ऊँचऽ चोटी प॑ चढ़ी क॑ पर्वतारोही भ्रातृत्व क॑ स्तब्ध करी देलकै, जेकरा स॑ सात साल केरऽ पिछला रिकॉर्ड क॑ तोड़ी देलकै ।

title: NOC urges not to hoard gas cylinders - The Rising Nepal
description: NOC urges not to hoard gas cylinders  The Rising Nepal
publisher.title: The Rising Nepal
full_article:
By A Staff Reporter, Kathmandu, Aug. 2: The Nepal Oil Corporation (NOC) has assured the public that the supply of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) remains normal across the country and urged consumers not to purchase cylinders unnecessarily.

Issuing a public notice on Saturday, the corporation said that despite media reports claiming a shortage of cooking gas in the market, its records show that LPG is being supplied daily in line with the demand.

The corporation said that it had already made arrangements for the sale and distribution of fully filled 14.2-kilogram LPG cylinders following its decision on July 15, 2026.

However, it said that some consumers have complained about difficulties in obtaining gas after the introduction of the new cylinder distribution system.

The NOC requested all LPG bottling industries to ensure smooth and adequate market supply.

It also instructed dealers to give priority to household consumers and maintain records of buyers, including their names, addresses and contact numbers, to ensure systematic distribution.

According to Manoj Kumar Thakur, spokesperson for the NOC, more than 100 LPG bullets are currently being loaded and dispatched daily from the Indian Oil Corporation (IOC).

"There is no problem importing LPG from IOC. More than 49,000 tonnes of LPG entered Nepal in July. Of this, around 26,500 tonnes entered during the last 15 days of the Nepali month of Saun. This shows that there is no need to worry about the supply of cooking gas," he told The Rising Nepal.

However, he said that demand for LPG had increased in recent days after the NOC resumed supplying fully filled LPG cylinders.

"The demand for LPG declined over the last four months—Chaitra, Baisakh, Jeth and Asar—when the NOC distributed half-filled cooking gas cylinders. After it started supplying fully filled cylinders from July 15, consumers rushed to refill their empty cylinders, creating temporary demand pressure," he said.

The monthly demand for LPG stood at around 32,000 to 38,000 tonnes over the past four months, compared to the normal monthly consumption of 45,000 to 46,000 tonnes.

He urged consumers to purchase LPG only when necessary instead of rushing to refill all their empty cylinders at once, so that supplies remain available for those who need them most. This shortfall has now created additional pressure on demand, he added.

To ease supply pressure in the Kathmandu Valley, the corporation has also arranged for the sale and distribution of cylinders of Nepal Gas, HP Gas, Everest Gas, Sugam Gas and Shreeram Gas from its Teku office starting from Saturday, between 11:00 am and 5:00 pm.

The cylinders will be distributed through the respective gas companies.

The corporation has asked consumers who fail to obtain LPG cylinders to contact its hotline at 01-5971902 during office hours.

Stating that the transportation and distribution of LPG are continuing without disruption and will remain regular in the coming days, the NOC appealed to consumers to buy gas only as required and not to hoard cylinders.

title: ‘Lost In Mandala’: Nepal’s first animated feature film to reach audiences through Apple Entertainment - Technology Khabar
description: ‘Lost In Mandala’: Nepal’s first animated feature film to reach audiences through Apple Entertainment  Technology Khabar
publisher.title: Technology Khabar
full_article:
काठमाडौं ।

Lost In Mandala, an animated fantasy adventure inspired by the spiritual traditions, mythology and landscapes of the Himalayas, is bringing a story rooted in Nepal to the global stage.

Created as Nepal’s first animated feature film for the global market, the film combines a culturally distinctive setting with a universal story of friendship, compassion, courage and self-discovery.

The film follows a twelve-year-old girl and her friends who find themselves trapped in a mysterious alternate dimension. As they encounter a sinister dark force, the friends must navigate an unfamiliar world and discover the power of love and compassion to overcome the threat and save their world.

The story draws on Nepal’s rich cultural and spiritual heritage while building a fantastical world designed to resonate with viewers across generations and geographies.

Apple Entertainment Pvt. Ltd., one of Nepal’s leading theatrical film distributors, is the official distribution partner for Lost In Mandala in Nepal and select international territories. The partnership will bring the film to the big screen through Apple Entertainment’s established theatrical distribution network, adding a locally rooted animated title with international ambitions to its portfolio.

The project marks a significant development for Nepal’s animation and creative sectors, demonstrating the potential to transform the country’s stories, mythology and visual heritage into feature-length productions designed for international audiences.

Lost In Mandala also brings together creative expertise from Nepal and Hollywood, combining local storytelling with experience from some of the world’s leading film and visual effects productions.

“With Lost In Mandala, we are proud to bring a story inspired by Nepal to the world and demonstrate the immense potential of our creative industry to tell globally relevant stories,” said Mr. Nakim Uddin, Executive Producer of Lost In Mandala, Chairman of Apple Entertainment Pvt. Ltd., Co-Founder of QFX Cinemas and Labim Mall.

“Lost In Mandala gives us an exciting opportunity to take a story inspired by Nepal to wider audiences, and we are proud to bring this culturally rooted film to theatres through our distribution network,” said Ms. Bipashyana Shrestha, Managing Director, Apple Entertainment Pvt. Ltd.

The film is created and directed by Mr. Kiran Bhakta Joshi, Founder and Co-CEO of Incessant Rain Studios and former Visual Effects Supervisor at Walt Disney Studios. Joshi worked on acclaimed productions including The Lion King, Beauty and the Beast and The Hunchback of Notre Dame.

With Lost In Mandala, he is bringing his international experience in visual effects and filmmaking to a project rooted in the cultural landscape of his home country.

The screenplay is written by Mr. Zack Stentz, whose Hollywood credits include Thor, X-Men: First Class and Netflix’s Jurassic World: Camp Cretaceous. His other credits include Rim of the World, Agent Cody Banks, and television series including Fringe, The Flash and Terminator: The Sarah Connor Chronicles.

Ms. Deepa Chipalu Joshi, Co-Founder and Co-CEO of Incessant Rain Studios, serves as Producer. An Executive VFX Producer, her credits include Yellowstone, Gangs of London and The Hunger Games: The Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes. She oversees the film’s production and international partnerships.

Lost In Mandala is being developed by Incessant Rain Studios in partnership with NIMB Ace Capital, bringing together creative, production and financial expertise to develop the project for international markets.

For Apple Entertainment, the partnership builds on its position as a distributor of international cinema in Nepal. The company is the official distribution partner for major Hollywood studios including Disney, Universal Pictures, Sony Pictures, Paramount Pictures and Warner Bros., as well as other global entertainment companies.

Through its rights for Lost In Mandala in Nepal and select international territories, Apple Entertainment will support the film’s theatrical journey and help introduce a Nepal-originated animated feature to a wider cinema-going audience.

With its distinctive visual world, Himalayan setting and internationally experienced creative team, Lost In Mandala represents an ambitious new chapter for animation from Nepal. The film brings together local cultural inspiration and global filmmaking expertise to tell a story whose central message, choosing compassion and connection in the face of darkness—can travel far beyond its place of origin.

वैश्विक बाजार लेली नेपाल केरऽ पहलऽ एनिमेटेड फीचर फिल्म के रूप म॑ बनलऽ ई फिल्म म॑ दोस्ती, करुणा, साहस आरू आत्म-खोज केरऽ सार्वभौमिक कहानी के साथ सांस्कृतिक रूप स॑ विशिष्ट परिवेश के संयोजन करलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

ई फिल्म एगो बारह साल के लड़की आरू ओकरऽ दोस्तऽ के कहानी छै जे खुद क॑ एगो रहस्यमय वैकल्पिक आयाम म॑ फंसलऽ पाबै छै । जेना-जेना हुनका सब के एकटा भयावह अन्हार शक्ति के सामना करय पड़ैत छनि, मित्र सब के एकटा अपरिचित दुनिया में नेविगेट करय पड़ैत छनि आ प्रेम आ करुणा के शक्ति के खोज करय पड़तनि जे खतरा पर काबू पाबि अपन दुनिया के बचा सकय.

कहानी नेपाल केरऽ समृद्ध सांस्कृतिक आरू आध्यात्मिक धरोहर के आकर्षण के साथ-साथ एगो विलक्षण दुनिया के निर्माण करै छै जे पीढ़ी-दर-पीढ़ी आरू भूगोल के दर्शकऽ के साथ गुंजायमान होय ​​लेली डिजाइन करलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

एप्पल एंटरटेनमेंट प्रा. लि. ई साझेदारी स॑ फिल्म क॑ एप्पल एंटरटेनमेंट केरऽ स्थापित थिएटर डिस्ट्रीब्यूशन नेटवर्क के माध्यम स॑ बड़ऽ पर्दा प॑ लानलऽ जैतै, जेकरा स॑ एकरऽ पोर्टफोलियो म॑ अंतरराष्ट्रीय महत्वाकांक्षा वाला स्थानीय रूप स॑ जड़ वाला एनिमेटेड टाइटल जोड़लऽ जैतै ।

ई परियोजना नेपाल केरऽ एनीमेशन आरू रचनात्मक क्षेत्र लेली एगो महत्वपूर्ण विकास के रूप म॑ सामने ऐलऽ छै, जेकरा स॑ देश केरऽ कहानी, पौराणिक कथा आरू दृश्य धरोहर क॑ अंतरराष्ट्रीय दर्शक लेली डिजाइन करलऽ गेलऽ फीचर-लंबाई केरऽ निर्माण म॑ बदलै के क्षमता के प्रदर्शन करलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

लॉस्ट इन मंडला म॑ नेपाल आरू हॉलीवुड केरऽ रचनात्मक विशेषज्ञता भी एक साथ लानलऽ गेलऽ छै, जेकरा म॑ स्थानीय कहानी क॑ दुनिया केरऽ कुछ प्रमुख फिल्म आरू विजुअल इफेक्ट्स प्रोडक्शन केरऽ अनुभव के साथ जोड़लऽ गेलऽ छै ।

एप्पल एंटरटेनमेंट प्रा. लिमिटेड, क्यूएफएक्स सिनेमाज एवं लबिम मॉल के सह-संस्थापक।

एप्पल एंटरटेनमेंट प्रा. लि।

ई फिल्म केरऽ निर्माण आरू निर्देशन इनसेसेंट रेन स्टूडियो केरऽ संस्थापक आरू सह-सीईओ आरू वाल्ट डिज्नी स्टूडियो केरऽ पूर्व विजुअल इफेक्ट्स सुपरवाइजर श्री किरण भक्त जोशी न॑ करलकै । जोशी न॑ द लायन किंग, ब्यूटी एंड द बीस्ट आरू द हंचबैक ऑफ नोट्रे डेम सहित प्रशंसित प्रोडक्शन प॑ काम करलकै ।

लॉस्ट इन मंडला के साथ हुनी अपनऽ गृह देश के सांस्कृतिक परिदृश्य म॑ जड़ जमाय क॑ एगो परियोजना म॑ विजुअल इफेक्ट आरू फिल्म निर्माण केरऽ अपनऽ अंतर्राष्ट्रीय अनुभव क॑ लान॑ छै ।

पटकथा श्री जैक स्टेंट्ज लिखने छै, जिनकर हॉलीवुड क्रेडिट म॑ थोर, एक्स-मेन: फर्स्ट क्लास आरू नेटफ्लिक्स केरऽ जुरासिक वर्ल्ड: कैम्प क्रीटेशियस शामिल छै । हुनकऽ अन्य श्रेय म॑ रिम ऑफ द वर्ल्ड, एजेंट कोडी बैंक्स, आरू फ्रींज, द फ्लैश आरू टर्मिनेटर: द सारा कॉनर क्रॉनिकल्स सहित टेलीविजन सीरीज शामिल छै ।

इन्सेसेंट रेन स्टूडियो केरऽ सह-संस्थापक आरू सह-सीईओ सुश्री दीपा चिपालू जोशी निर्माता के रूप म॑ काम करै छै । एक कार्यकारी वीएफएक्स निर्माता, हुनकऽ श्रेय म॑ येलोस्टोन, गैंग्स ऑफ लंदन आरू द हंगर गेम्स: द बैलेड ऑफ सोंगबर्ड्स एंड स्नेक शामिल छै । ओ फिल्म के निर्माण आ अंतर्राष्ट्रीय साझेदारी के देखरेख करैत छथि.

लॉस्ट इन मंडला क॑ इंसेसेंट रेन स्टूडियो न॑ एनआईएमबी ऐस कैपिटल के साथ साझेदारी म॑ विकसित करी रहलऽ छै, जेकरा म॑ अंतरराष्ट्रीय बाजार लेली ई परियोजना क॑ विकसित करै लेली रचनात्मक, उत्पादन आरू वित्तीय विशेषज्ञता क॑ एक साथ लानलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

एप्पल एंटरटेनमेंट के लेल ई साझेदारी नेपाल के अंतर्राष्ट्रीय सिनेमा के वितरक के रूप में अपन स्थिति के आधार पर बनल अछि. ई कंपनी डिज्नी, यूनिवर्सल पिक्चर्स, सोनी पिक्चर्स, पैरामाउंट पिक्चर्स आरू वार्नर ब्रदर्स सहित प्रमुख हॉलीवुड स्टूडियो के साथ-साथ अन्य वैश्विक मनोरंजन कंपनी के आधिकारिक वितरण भागीदार छै ।

नेपाल आरू चुनिंदा अंतर्राष्ट्रीय क्षेत्रऽ म॑ लॉस्ट इन मंडला लेली अपनऽ अधिकार के माध्यम स॑ एप्पल एंटरटेनमेंट फिल्म केरऽ रंगमंच यात्रा क॑ समर्थन करतै आरू नेपाल स॑ बनलऽ एनिमेटेड फीचर क॑ व्यापक सिनेमा देखै वाला दर्शक के बीच पेश करै म॑ मदद करतै ।

अपनऽ विशिष्ट दृश्य दुनिया, हिमालयन सेटिंग आरू अंतर्राष्ट्रीय अनुभवी रचनात्मक टीम के साथ, लोस्ट इन मंडला नेपाल स॑ एनीमेशन लेली एगो महत्वाकांक्षी नया अध्याय के प्रतिनिधित्व करै छै । ई फिल्म स्थानीय सांस्कृतिक प्रेरणा आरू वैश्विक फिल्म निर्माण विशेषज्ञता क॑ एक साथ लानी क॑ एगो ऐसनऽ कहानी कहै छै जेकरऽ केंद्रीय संदेश, अन्हार के सामना म॑ करुणा आरू कनेक्शन चुनना-अपनऽ मूल स्थान स॑ बहुत आगू के यात्रा करी सकै छै ।

title: Chhayanath gaining traction gradually - The Rising Nepal
description: Chhayanath gaining traction gradually  The Rising Nepal
publisher.title: The Rising Nepal
full_article:
By Our Correspondent, Mugu, Aug. 2: The arrival of pilgrims at the Chhayanath pilgrimage site in Mugu, a shared centre of faith for Hindus and Buddhists, has begun to increase with the Janai Purnima festival approaching.

Every year, thousands of devotees from districts including Jumla, Kalikot, Dailekh, Jajarkot and Humla visit Chhayanath Dham to seek salvation, perform rituals for the liberation of departed ancestors and observe other religious rites.

Located in the forest area of Dolpu village in Mugum Karmarong Rural Municipality, Chhayanath is regarded as an ancient pilgrimage site by Hindus. Buddhist devotees also visit the site with equal reverence.

According to Buddhist scholar Lama Guru Dorje Lama, Buddhists traditionally worship the three differently coloured peaks of Chhayanath Himal as manifestations of Manjushri Buddha, Avalokiteshvara Buddha and Vajrapani Buddha. This tradition, he said, has made Chhayanath a symbol of religious and cultural harmony between Hinduism and Buddhism.

According to Chhayanath Temple priest Purna Prasad Chaulagain, there is a widespread belief that bathing at Chhayanath and worshipping there brings liberation from sins, while offering pinda, ritual offerings for departed ancestors, brings spiritual merit.

It is also believed that dhamis, traditional spiritual practitioners, attain spiritual powers by bathing in the sacred waters of Chhayanath.

He said the temple is opened only during Janai Purnima each year, when large numbers of devotees gather at the site. During the rest of the year, the pilgrimage site remains largely deserted because of the extreme cold and difficult terrain.

It takes about two days of walking from the district headquarters, Gamgadhi, to reach Chhayanath Dham. To make the pilgrimage more accessible, an idol of Chhayanath has been installed at Chainagaun near Gamgadhi, where daily worship is performed.

Every year, on Janai Purnima, Aunsi and Saptami, idols of Shiva-Parvati, Ganesha, Buddha and various goddesses, made of ancient multi-metal alloys, are carried from the temple at Chainagaun to Chhayanath Dham in accordance with special religious rituals. After the Janai Purnima worship is completed, the priests return to Chainagaun with the idols.

According to Dhankarna Malla of Soru Rural Municipality-5, the tradition of offering pinda to Chhayanath before performing the ritual at Kashi in Varanasi, India, is still maintained. This, he said, indicates that the religious significance of Chhayanath extends beyond Nepal.

Priest Asine Hamal said many devotees were still unaware of the historical and religious significance of Chhayanath Dham due to inadequate publicity and promotion.

Chhayanath is currently being connected by an access road with financial support from the Karnali Provincial Government and facilitation by the Division Forest Office, according to Chhayanath Karmarong Rural Municipality chairperson Chhiring Kyapne Lama.

He expressed confidence that Chhayanath could become a major religious tourism destination if the Karnali Provincial government develops the necessary infrastructure in accordance with a master plan, creating new employment and income-generating opportunities for local residents.

title: Celebrated Nepali climber Purja's body found in northern Pakistan - A News
description: Celebrated Nepali climber Purja's body found in northern Pakistan  A News
publisher.title: A News
full_article:
Rescuers on Sunday found the body of celebrated Nepali climber Nirmal Purja, who, along with nine mountaineers, was killed during an expedition in northern Pakistan earlier this week, an official confirmed to Anadolu.

Purja's body was found at approximately 5,700 meters (18,700 feet) on Broad Peak -- three days after he and other members of his team were reported missing following an avalanche, said Ayaz Shigri, secretary general of the Alpine Club of Pakistan, the country's official mountaineering body.

Shigri said that seven bodies and parts of an eighth body had so far been found, while a search operation would continue for the recovery of the remaining two bodies.

Purja was leading a 10-member expedition that included Nadhira Ahmed Abdullah Al Harthy of Oman; Sohail Sakhi of Pakistan; Wang Zhong of China; Mallory Geis of the US; and Pur Bahadur Gurung Yukta, Kili Pemba Sherpa, Nima Sherpa, Nawang Thindu Sherpa and Gyalu Sherpa, all of Nepal.

The 8,047-meter (26,400-foot) Broad Peak is located in Pakistan's northern Gilgit-Baltistan region, which is home to five of the 14 peaks above 8,000 meters (26,246 feet), including K2, where mountaineering accidents are not rare.

title: Bodies of 4 climbers including Nirmal Purja recovered - The Rising Nepal
description: Bodies of 4 climbers including Nirmal Purja recovered  The Rising Nepal
publisher.title: The Rising Nepal
full_article:
Kathmandu, Aug. 3: Bodies of four mountaineers including Nirmal Purja who went missing while climbing the Broad Peak (8,047 metre) in Pakistan have been recovered at about 5,700 m on the mountain.

The Alpine Club of Pakistan (ACP) informed in an Instagram post on Sunday afternoon that the bodies of Purja, Wang Zhong, Nima Sherpa and Kili Pemba Sherpa 'Kilu' were recovered while the rescuers also confirmed the presence of one additional body at a significantly higher elevation.

"Due to the extremely hazardous terrain and prevailing conditions, it is unlikely that a recovery attempt will be made at this stage," said the Club while commending the extraordinary courage and professionalism of the Pakistani and Nepali rescue team carrying out this difficult mission under some of the world’s most challenging high-altitude conditions.

The dead bodies were being brought down to Camp 1 of Peak, world's 12th highest mountain, and downwards by the ground rescue team.

With this the number of bodies recovered reaches eight. However, the APC maintained that the information was preliminary field report and is subject to further confirmation.

The bodies of Nadhira Ahmed Abdullah Al Harthy of Oman and Pur Bahadur Gurung of Nepal were recovered on Friday while Gyalu Sherpa's body was recovered on Saturday.

Quoting ACP President Irfan Arshad, Pakistan's Dawn reported that the remains believed to be of American climber Sarah Mallory Geis were also recovered. Purja was leading a 10-member team – six Nepalis and one each from China, Oman, Pakistan and the United States.

Myagdi mourns Purja's death

Our Myagdi Correspondent reported that Purja's birth place in Myagdi district is mourning his death. He was born in Dana of Annapurna Rural Municipality-3, and is being remembered across the district for his extraordinary achievements in mountaineering. In honour of his passing, Annapurna Rural Municipality has declared Monday a day of mourning.

In a condolence statement issued on Sunday, Annapurana's Chair Bharat Kumar Pun announced that all municipal offices, ward offices, health institutions and community schools under the municipality would remain closed on Monday, except for essential services.

In its statement, the municipality said Purja's contribution to taking Nepal's mountaineering sector to new heights, establishing the identity and prestige of Nepali climbers on the international stage, and setting an unparalleled example of courage, leadership and dedication would always be remembered.

Acting Chief of the District Coordination Committee, Dil Kumari Khatri, expressed sorrow over his death, saying the district had lost one of its most talented mountaineers and the nation had lost a source of immense pride.

The 43-year-old mountaineer and former British Army personnel had set a world record by climbing all 14 mountains above 8,000 metres in the shortest time ever, in six months six days.

"His impact reached far beyond any one nation, more than the records themselves, he gave people everywhere a reason to believe that the impossible was simply something no one had dared attempt hard enough yet, inspiring dreamers and climbers across the globe to chase what once seemed unreachable," said the ACP.

It termed that Purja's death was a loss on the very mountains he so loved is a devastating blow to the global mountaineering family. "But his legacy of pushing limits, of proving that the impossible is only impossible until someone dares to do it, will endure in every climber, everywhere, who follows the trail he blazed," it said in the social media post.

'Truly saddened'

Prince William of the UK said that he was 'truly saddened' by the tragic death of Purja and those who lost their lives in the avalanche.

"Nims (Nirmal) served with distinction in the British Armed Forces before becoming one of the world’s greatest mountaineers, putting Nepalese climbers on the map. His relentless pursuit of what seemed impossible, combined with his humility and selflessness, made him truly unique," he wrote in his post on X.

Earlier, on Sunday afternoon, Nepal's Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MoFA) informed in a statement that the Embassy of Nepal in Islamabad is facilitating the necessary arrangements for the repatriation of the deceased climbers' remains to Nepal.

"We commend the courage and dedication of the Pakistani and Nepali mountaineering teams involved in conducting these challenging rescue efforts in the high-altitude terrain," it said.

title: Opinion | Madhesh tests Nepal’s secular credentials - The Kathmandu Post
description: Opinion | Madhesh tests Nepal’s secular credentials  The Kathmandu Post
publisher.title: The Kathmandu Post
full_article:
After a week of communal turmoil, Madhesh is finally settling down. The home minister’s crisis management strategy has helped bring leaders of the Hindu and Muslim communities to the talks table. The prime minister’s earnest outreach to political actors in the region, though a tad belated, has helped establish a sense of accountability and fraternity. However, the flames of communalism hardly die down with ad hoc measures. Bureaucratic management of the communal tension must be followed by long-term strategies to address deep-rooted problems, beginning with the concept of secularism itself.

From what we have heard from the media, Prime Minister Balendra Shah is firm in his commitment to secularism. His argument, as his interlocutors put forth, is clear: Any debate on the desecularisation of the Nepali state entails an unviable quest to undo republicanism and federalism. Based on this information, we can rest assured that secularism as a political principle of the Nepali state is in good hands—at least for now. But we cannot remain complacent.

First things first, the timing of the communal tension tells us something about a subterranean effort underway in Madhesh to undo secularism. Certainly, the tensions began with a display of machismo from men belonging to two different communities in Kaptanganj of Sunsari: Hindu devotees on the Bol Bam procession blasting religious hymns at night and local Muslim youths trying to cut the former down to size. Enter the trigger-happy police, and a local brawl explodes into a vulgar display of communal hatred spanning an entire province.

Consultations on constitution amendment are underway at the national level, and this is the right time for anti-secularists to intervene. The signs are already out there: Members of various Hindutva-aligned outfits are in constant negotiations with the home minister, with a prominent demand of a return to ‘Hindu Rashtra.’ The home minister is said to have circumvented this demand, instead committing to more viable outcomes in the immediate run. But the negotiations have veered towards reinforcing a unilateral communal suspicion, including a greater scrutiny of madrassas.

Yes, scrutinise Madrassas, but also mandirs. Incidents in the last few years have shown that communalism is not the prerogative of just one religion or community. Instead, we are too quick to provoke and be provoked: Social media used to share communally insensitive videos; religious processions rerouted through the village of a different community just to provoke. Banke, Dhanusa and Sarlahi have seen similar cases of communal tension in the recent past, reinforcing the belief that the same grammar of communalism is being taught across Madhesh: Individuals from a certain community commit verbal or physical acts that undermine communal harmony, followed by the politicisation of the incidents. The Armed Police Force recorded 25 incidents of religious or ethnic conflict between the fiscal years 2020-21 and 2023-24. But who is fueling the communal flare-ups in Madhesh?

An obvious suspect is the wave of communalism sweeping through the bordering towns in Bihar and Uttar Pradesh of India. The open border presents a significant challenge in containing the politicisation of religion, often sponsored by political parties, as is the case with India. The rise of the Bharatiya Janata Party has been concomitant with the shrinking of the secular public sphere in India, and this is no sheer coincidence. State-sponsored hatred of the Muslim minority has been a reality in the last 12 years, ever since the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh-backed BJP came into power. This has paid the party off very well: “Hindu khatre mein hain” (The Hindus are in danger) has been the most consistent political slogan of the BJP, which likes to use the suffix of ‘jihad’ against an entire community wherever it suits.

You don’t always need your apparatchiks to do the legwork: RSS’s brand of Hindutva has spilled over digitally as well, with Nepalis increasingly getting comfortable with the slogan “Jai Shree Ram”, replacing the local version, “Jai Siya Ram”. The politicisation of Hinduism on the streets of Madhesh last week has helped lay the groundwork for a return to Hinduism as a political principle. Once the road to the politicisation of religion has been paved and the secular fabric of the society torn, turning back becomes difficult, if not impossible. But turn we must. And how?

As the latest bout of communalism in Madhesh has shown, a state’s toleration of different religions does not automatically translate into religious tolerance in society. The Nepali state has certainly ensured the recognition and survival of Muslims as a political community; but it has, as of now, failed to secularise the society in a way that the Muslims feel acknowledged as the co-builders of the society itself. The state, therefore, must see to it that official secularism translates into a lived reality in Nepal. This begins with differentiating Hinduism as a cultural practice from its political offshoot, Hindutva, which is often intolerant and even violent—and replicating this for all religious communities.

Apart from the obvious operationalisation of political Hindutva in Madhesh, the current imbroglio is also the result of our internal failures at institutionalisation of secularism in the past two decades. If the tipping point came in the form of violence in Madhesh, the conditions had also been laid out in the vacuum of the public sphere left by political parties, successive governments and civil society. The Nepali state did the right thing by adopting secularism through the reinstated parliament in 2006, and then codifying it through the interim constitution of 2007 and the 2015 constitution. However, as Nepal’s political and civic spaces brimmed with debates over state restructuring, most vociferously over federalism, secularism remained just an et cetera.

Every political party shied away from talking about secularism, as if they had committed a crime by letting it seep into the interim constitution. Civil society members said in hushed voices that although secularism was a theoretical prerequisite for democracy, Nepali Hinduism wasn’t bad either. Antisecularists, thereby, kept abusing secularism as a foreign import imposed by NGOs to expand ‘foreign’ religions, including Christianity and Islam, and undermine Hinduism. In the absence of a sustained debate on the affirmative effects of secularism, common Nepalis have, therefore, felt that it was shoved down their throats, and hence a muted acceptance of the idea that Nepal can actually go back to Hinduism.

The communal flare-up this time has laid bare the fault lines of the official secularism we hastily adopted as the Nepali state’s political principle twenty years ago. It is now time to return to the beginning and establish that secularism isn’t a foreign idea sheepishly inserted into our constitution but a consciousness and a lived experience. Only when it becomes an integral part of our cultural praxis does secularism find its true meaning and acceptance.

एक सप्ताह के साम्प्रदायिक उथल-पुथल के बाद आखिरकार मधेश बसि रहल अछि। गृहमंत्री केरऽ संकट प्रबंधन रणनीति स॑ हिन्दू आरू मुस्लिम समुदाय केरऽ नेता सिनी क॑ वार्ता के मेज प॑ लानै म॑ मदद मिललऽ छै । प्रधानमंत्री केरऽ ई क्षेत्र केरऽ राजनीतिक अभिनेता सिनी के गंभीरता स॑ संपर्क भले ही कुछ देरी होय गेलऽ छै, लेकिन जवाबदेही आरू भ्रातृत्व के भावना स्थापित करै म॑ मदद मिललऽ छै । मुदा, तदर्थ उपायक संग साम्प्रदायिकताक लौ शायदे मरि जाइत अछि । साम्प्रदायिक तनाव के नौकरशाही प्रबंधन के बाद गहींर जड़ जमाय वाला समस्या के समाधान के लेल दीर्घकालिक रणनीति बनाबय पड़त, जेकर शुरुआत स्वयं धर्मनिरपेक्षता के अवधारणा सं होयत.

मीडिया स जे सुनलौं ओहि स प्रधानमंत्री बलेन्द्र शाह धर्मनिरपेक्षता क प्रति अपन प्रतिबद्धता पर अडिग छथि। हुनकऽ तर्क, जेना कि हुनकऽ वार्ताकारऽ न॑ रखलकै, स्पष्ट छै कि नेपाली राज्य केरऽ अधर्मनिरपेक्षता प॑ कोनो भी बहस म॑ गणतंत्रवाद आरू संघवाद क॑ पूर्ववत करै के अव्यावहारिक खोज के जरूरत छै । एहि जानकारीक आधार पर हम सभ निश्चिंत भ' सकैत छी जे नेपाली राज्यक राजनीतिक सिद्धांतक रूप मे धर्मनिरपेक्षता नीक हाथ मे अछि-कम सँ कम एखन धरि। मुदा हम सभ आत्मसंतुष्ट नहि रहि सकैत छी।

पहिल बात पहिने साम्प्रदायिक तनाव के समय धर्मनिरपेक्षता के पूर्ववत करय लेल मधेश में चलि रहल भूमिगत प्रयास के बारे में किछु बताबैत अछि. निश्चित रूप स॑ तनाव केरऽ शुरुआत सुनसरी केरऽ कप्तानगंज म॑ दू अलग-अलग समुदाय स॑ संबंधित पुरुषऽ के माचिस्मो के प्रदर्शन स॑ भेलै : बोल बम जुलूस म॑ हिन्दू भक्त रात म॑ धार्मिक भजन के धमाका करी रहलऽ छेलै आरू स्थानीय मुस्लिम युवा सिनी न॑ पूर्व क॑ आकार म॑ काटै के कोशिश करी रहलऽ छेलै । ट्रिगर-खुश पुलिस में प्रवेश करू, आ एकटा स्थानीय झगड़ा एकटा पूरा प्रांत में पसरल सांप्रदायिक घृणाक फूहड़ प्रदर्शन में विस्फोट भ' जाइत अछि.

संविधान संशोधन पर राष्ट्रीय स्तर पर परामर्श चलि रहल अछि, आ धर्मनिरपेक्ष विरोधी के हस्तक्षेप करय के ई सही समय अछि. संकेत पहिने स॑ ही बाहर छै : हिंदुत्व स॑ जुड़लऽ विभिन्न संगठनऽ के सदस्य गृहमंत्री स॑ लगातार बातचीत करी रहलऽ छै, जेकरा म॑ ‘हिन्दू राष्ट्र’ म॑ वापसी के प्रमुख मांग छै ।कहल जाय छै कि गृह मंत्री न॑ ई मांग क॑ दरकिनार करी क॑ एकरऽ बदला म॑ तत्काल आरू व्यवहार्य परिणाम लेली प्रतिबद्धता जतैलकै । लेकिन वार्ता एकतरफा सांप्रदायिक शंका क॑ मजबूत करै के तरफ मुड़लऽ छै, जेकरा म॑ मदरसा केरऽ अधिक जांच भी शामिल छै ।

हँ, मद्रासक जाँच करू, मुदा मंदिरक सेहो। पिछला किछु साल के घटना स पता चलल अछि जे साम्प्रदायिकता सिर्फ एकटा धर्म या समुदाय के विशेषाधिकार नै अछि। बल्कि, हम सब भड़काबै में आ भड़काबै में बहुत जल्दी छी: सोशल मीडिया में सांप्रदायिक रूप सं संवेदनहीन वीडियो शेयर कयल जाइत छल; धार्मिक जुलूस के एकटा अलग समुदाय के गाम के माध्यम स रिरूट क देल गेल सिर्फ भड़काबै के लेल | बाँके, धनुषा आरू सर्लाही म॑ हाल के अतीत म॑ भी ऐन्हऽ ही साम्प्रदायिक तनाव के मामला देखलऽ गेलऽ छै, जेकरा स॑ ई मान्यता क॑ मजबूत करलऽ गेलऽ छै कि पूरा मधेश म॑ साम्प्रदायिकता के वही व्याकरण सिखालऽ जाय रहलऽ छै : एक निश्चित समुदाय के व्यक्ति मौखिक या शारीरिक काम करै छै जेकरा स॑ साम्प्रदायिक सौहार्द क॑ कमजोर करी दै छै, ओकरऽ बाद घटना के राजनीतिकरण होय छै । सशस्त्र पुलिस बल वित्तीय वर्ष 2020-21 आ 2023-24 के बीच धार्मिक या जातीय संघर्ष के 25 घटना दर्ज केलक अछि। मुदा मधेश मे साम्प्रदायिक भड़काव के के ईंधन द रहल अछि?

एकटा स्पष्ट संदिग्ध अछि भारतक बिहार आ उत्तर प्रदेशक सीमावर्ती शहर मे साम्प्रदायिकताक लहर। खुला सीमा धर्म केरऽ राजनीतिकरण क॑ रोकै म॑ एगो महत्वपूर्ण चुनौती पेश करै छै, जेकरा अक्सर राजनीतिक दल द्वारा प्रायोजित करलऽ जाय छै, जेना कि भारत के मामला छै । भारतीय जनता पार्टी केरऽ उदय भारत केरऽ धर्मनिरपेक्ष सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र केरऽ सिकुड़न के साथ-साथ रहलऽ छै, आरू ई कोनो सरासर संयोग नै छै । मुस्लिम अल्पसंख्यक के प्रति राज्य प्रायोजित घृणा पिछला 12 साल में हकीकत बनल अछि, जहिया सं राष्ट्रीय स्वयंसेवक संघ समर्थित भाजपा सत्ता में आयल अछि. एहि स पार्टी कए बहुत नीक फल भेटल अछि : “हिन्दू खतरे में हैं” (हिन्दू खतरा मे अछि) भाजपा क सबस सुसंगत राजनीतिक नारा रहल अछि, जे जतय कतहु सूट करैत अछि, कोनो पूरा समुदाय क खिलाफ ‘जिहाद’ क प्रत्यय क प्रयोग करब पसिन करैत अछि।

लेगवर्क करय लेल हरदम अपन अपारात्चिक के जरूरत नहिं पड़ैत अछि : आरएसएस के ब्रांड हिन्दुत्व डिजिटल रूप सं सेहो छलकि गेल अछि, जाहि मे नेपाली लोकनि “जय श्री राम” के नारा सं तेजी सं सहज भ’ रहल छथि, जे स्थानीय संस्करण “जय सिया राम” के जगह ल’ गेल अछि. पिछला सप्ताह मधेश के सड़क पर हिन्दू धर्म के राजनीतिकरण के कारण हिन्दू धर्म के राजनीतिक सिद्धांत के रूप में वापसी के आधार तैयार करय में मदद मिलल अछि. एक बेर धर्मक राजनीतिकरणक बाट प्रशस्त भ' गेल आ समाजक धर्मनिरपेक्ष ताना-बाना फाटि गेल त' पाछू घुमब असंभव नहि त' कठिन भ' जाइत अछि. मुदा घुमब हमरा सभकेँ अवश्य। आ कोना ?

जेना कि मधेश केरऽ साम्प्रदायिकता केरऽ ताजा दौर स॑ पता चललै कि कोय राज्य केरऽ अलग-अलग धर्म केरऽ सहिष्णुता समाज म॑ धार्मिक सहिष्णुता म॑ स्वतः नै बदली जाय छै । नेपाली राज्य निश्चित रूप स मुसलमान कए राजनीतिक समुदाय क रूप मे मान्यता आ अस्तित्व सुनिश्चित केलक अछि; लेकिन ई, अभी तलक, समाज क॑ ऐन्हऽ धर्मनिरपेक्ष बनाबै म॑ विफल रहलऽ छै कि मुसलमान खुद समाज केरऽ सह-निर्माता के रूप म॑ स्वीकार करलऽ गेलऽ महसूस करै छै । अतः राज्य के ई देखना जरूरी छै कि सरकारी धर्मनिरपेक्षता नेपाल में जीवित यथार्थ में परिणत होय जाय । एकरऽ शुरुआत हिन्दू धर्म क॑ एक सांस्कृतिक प्रथा के रूप म॑ ओकरऽ राजनीतिक शाखा हिन्दुत्व स॑ अलग करै स॑ होय छै, जे अक्सर असहिष्णु आरू यहां तक ​​कि हिंसक भी होय छै-आरू सब धार्मिक समुदाय लेली एकरऽ नकल करै स॑ होय छै ।

मधेश में राजनीतिक हिन्दुत्व के स्पष्ट परिचालन के अलावा वर्तमान उलझन पिछला दू दशक में धर्मनिरपेक्षता के संस्थागतीकरण में हमर सबहक आंतरिक असफलता के परिणाम सेहो अछि | मधेशमे जँ टिप्पिंग प्वाइंट हिंसाक रूपमे आबि गेल तँ राजनीतिक दल, क्रमिक सरकार आ नागरिक समाज द्वारा छोड़ल गेल सार्वजनिक क्षेत्रक वैक्यूममे सेहो शर्त बिछाओल गेल छल । नेपाली राज्य 2006 मे पुनर्स्थापित संसद के माध्यम स धर्मनिरपेक्षता के अपनाबैत, आ फेर 2007 के अंतरिम संविधान आ 2015 के संविधान के माध्यम स एकरा संहिताबद्ध क सही काज केलक। लेकिन, जेना-जेना नेपाल केरऽ राजनीतिक आरू नागरिक स्थान राज्य पुनर्गठन प॑ बहस स॑ भरलऽ छेलै, सबसें जादा संघीयता प॑ बहस स॑ भरलऽ छेलै, धर्मनिरपेक्षता बस एक इत्यादि ही रहलऽ ।

हर राजनीतिक दल धर्मनिरपेक्षता के बात करय सं परहेज करैत छल, जेना कोनो अपराध के अंतरिम संविधान मे घुसय द क केने हो. नागरिक समाज के सदस्य सब चुपचाप आवाज में कहलनि जे भले लोकतंत्र के लेल धर्मनिरपेक्षता सैद्धांतिक पूर्व शर्त अछि मुदा नेपाली हिन्दू धर्म सेहो खराब नहिं अछि. धर्मनिरपेक्ष विरोधी, ऐन्हऽ करी क॑ धर्मनिरपेक्षता क॑ गैर सरकारी संगठनऽ द्वारा ईसाई आरू इस्लाम सहित ‘विदेशी’ धर्मऽ के विस्तार आरू हिन्दू धर्म क॑ कमजोर करै लेली लगाय देलऽ गेलऽ विदेशी आयात के रूप म॑ दुरुपयोग करतें रहलै । धर्मनिरपेक्षता के सकारात्मक प्रभाव पर निरंतर बहस के अभाव में आम नेपाली सब के, अतः, ई महसूस भेल अछि जे एकरा कंठ में धकेलि देल गेल अछि, आ ताहि लेल ई विचार के म्यूट स्वीकृति जे नेपाल वास्तव में हिन्दू धर्म में वापस जा सकैत अछि.

एहि बेर जे साम्प्रदायिक भड़क उठल अछि ताहि सं बीस साल पहिने हम सभ जल्दबाजी मे नेपाली राज्यक राजनीतिक सिद्धांतक रूप मे अपनाओल गेल सरकारी धर्मनिरपेक्षताक दोष रेखा उजागर भ’ गेल अछि. आब समय आबि गेल अछि जे शुरुआत मे वापस आबि ई स्थापित करी जे धर्मनिरपेक्षता कोनो विदेशी विचार नहि अछि जे हमरा सभक संविधान मे भेड़ियाधसान जकाँ घुसाओल गेल अछि बल्कि एकटा चेतना आ एकटा जीवित अनुभव अछि. जखन ई हमरऽ सांस्कृतिक प्रैक्सिस के अभिन्न अंग बनी जाय छै तखनी धर्मनिरपेक्षता के अपनऽ असली अर्थ आरू स्वीकृति मिलै छै ।

title: Why Nepal Needs Seamless Bullet Train - The Rising Nepal
description: Why Nepal Needs Seamless Bullet Train  The Rising Nepal
publisher.title: The Rising Nepal
full_article:
Modern connectivity often prioritises straight paths, speed, and safety parameters to minimise travel time and cost. The incorporation of tunnel and high-bridge technologies into highway and railway construction has brought about a fundamental change in transportation infrastructure design. Over the last few years, both of our neighbours have demonstrated their engineering prowess by opening high-speed rail and road corridors using cutting-edge technology.

China builds and operates the world's largest high-speed rail network, stretching around 50,000 km with an operational speed of up to 350 km/h. The Indian bullet train programme was ramped up from 2020-21 with the completion of the land acquisition process in the 508-km Mumbai-Ahmedabad corridor. This under-construction train corridor is scheduled for launch in August 2027 with a 320 km/h operational speed, and is expected to reduce travel time from 7 hours to 2 hours. Both Indian and Chinese bullet trains have a common feature of a standard gauge system; both of them roll on a 1435 mm track width.

India has adopted a standard gauge system from their traditional broad gauge (1676 mm) for the high-speed rails and newly added metro trains. It has applied Shinkansen Technology to the bullet train. Extreme topography, technical and seismic hazards, steep descents, economic viability, etc., may limit us to think immediately about Kathmandu-Kerung high-speed rail, but a conventional electric train with moderate speed running on a standard gauge system is satisfactory for now.

Railway master plan

The Rastriya Swatantra Party (RSP) in its election manifesto talked about the preparation of 50- year-railway master plan that prioritises the East-West railway as a backbone for human and goods transport and the branch railway networks that connect Kathmandu, Pokhara, Dang, Surkhet, and several cities in the Tarai, and further beyond, India and China.

Today, speed has become an integral part of human life. To commute from Mechi to Mahakali (945 km), a bullet train usually takes around 3.10 hours, whereas a conventional type electric one may take 6 to 9 hours. Maybe, at present, it seems an ambitious project for Nepal, given its budgetary constraints. But choosing the right project from the beginning will be more beneficial in the long term. For the time being, designing the conventional electric railway corridor with future high-speed upgrade capacity wouldn’t be a correct choice because project correction requires a large sum of additional money.

Tunnel construction, maintaining curves and geometry, sturdy bridges, state-of-the-art signalling, 25 kV electrification, J-slab track system, future-compatible stations, etc., are some basic requirements for high-speed rails. Integration of our railways with the high-speed railway corridor of the northern and eastern cities of India would be instrumental in tapping our potential in cultural and religious tourism. Today, in the absence of seamless and affordable cross-border connectivity, a large number of Indian tourists cannot easily travel to Nepal.

The good news, however, is that India is planning to bring its bullet train network to our proximity. The Delhi-Varanasi and the Varanasi-Siliguri routes are in surveying and planning phases. Connecting Siliguri from Kakarbhitta and Delhi from Attaria or Mahendranagar with the standard-gauge bullet train tracks will ultimately provide us access to major Indian cities.

The East-West, Kathmandu-Tarai, and Kathmandu-Pokhara corridors are principal arteries of Nepal's transportation networks for industrial, tourism, and trade activities. Our youths are desperate for rapid development. Keeping their aspiration in focus, the government should revise and introduce high-speed rail infrastructure in the main transport corridors of Nepal. This, however, doesn’t mean that all our branch corridors should be equipped with the same facilities; based on terrain and geography, we can adopt conventional or semi-high-speed electric trains as well.

The government should have an in-depth analysis of its own party's 50-year railway master plan if we are to gear up for regional mobility with speed and accuracy. For global export, even the Indian Railways is manufacturing a standard-gauge variant of the Vande Bharat, making it compatible with a widely used track gauge in Asia, Africa, and South America. However, it seems that we are still not in a position to accept broad-gauge track for the 136-km Kathmandu-Raxual route, as the project is proceeding to the DPR finalisation stage.

Path of prosperity

One country with a multiple-gauge system will surely invite various problems on their operation and maintenance. If so, then no planning or late planning is better than wrong planning. Connecting India and China with two different gauge systems against the backdrop of security, technological, or any other reason directly affects our own interests. Seamless internal connection and access to two big population corridors should be our top priority.

Therefore, choosing speed with widely accepted technology in our railway system could only lead us to the path of prosperity. Instead of accepting gift projects on this new avenue, we should demonstrate our own strength by introducing the best technology that is easy, cheap, and practical for us. Ten years down the line, countries like China, Japan, and many European countries will be in a position to roll their bullet trains up to a speed of 500 km/h. Therefore, having a vision of a 300-320 km/h capable bullet train corridor in the main transportation arteries of Nepal within a decade is logical and justifiable for development-deprived Nepali people.





(The author is a former Senior Engineer of the Nepali Army.pthapa.ktm@gmail.com)

आधुनिक कनेक्टिविटी अक्सर सीधा मार्ग, गति, आ सुरक्षा पैरामीटर कें प्राथमिकता देयत छै, ताकि यात्रा कें समय आ लागत कम सं कम भ सकय. राजमार्ग आरू रेलवे निर्माण म॑ सुरंग आरू हाई-ब्रिज तकनीक क॑ शामिल करला स॑ परिवहन बुनियादी ढाँचा के डिजाइन म॑ मौलिक बदलाव आबी गेलऽ छै । पिछला किछु साल मे हमर दुनू पड़ोसी देश अत्याधुनिक तकनीक क उपयोग कए हाई स्पीड रेल आ सड़क गलियारा खोलि कए अपन इंजीनियरिंग पराक्रम क प्रदर्शन केलथि अछि।

चीन दुनिया केरऽ सबस॑ बड़ऽ हाई स्पीड रेल नेटवर्क के निर्माण आरू संचालन करै छै, जे लगभग ५०,००० किमी तक फैललऽ छै आरू एकरऽ परिचालन गति ३५० किमी/घंटा तलक छै । 508 किलोमीटर के मुंबई-अहमदाबाद गलियारा मँ जमीन अधिग्रहण प्रक्रिया पूरा होला के साथ ही 2020-21 स॑ भारतीय बुलेट ट्रेन कार्यक्रम क॑ तेज करी देलऽ गेलै । ई निर्माणाधीन ट्रेन गलियारा अगस्त २०२७ म॑ ३२० किमी/घंटा के परिचालन गति स॑ शुरू करलऽ जाय वाला छै, आरू एकरा स॑ यात्रा के समय ७ घंटा स॑ घटी क॑ २ घंटा होय के उम्मीद छै । भारतीय आ चीनी दुनू बुलेट ट्रेनमें मानक गेज प्रणालीक एकटा समान विशेषता छैक ; दुनू 1435 मिमी ट्रैक चौड़ाई पर रोल करैत अछि ।

भारत न॑ हाई स्पीड रेल आरू नव जोड़लऽ गेलऽ मेट्रो ट्रेन लेली अपनऽ पारंपरिक ब्रॉड गेज (१६७६ मिमी) स॑ मानक गेज सिस्टम अपनान॑ छै । एहि मे बुलेट ट्रेन मे शिनकांसेन टेक्नोलॉजी लागू कैल गेल अछि। चरम स्थलाकृति, तकनीकी आ भूकम्पीय खतरा, खड़ी उतराई, आर्थिक व्यवहार्यता आदि हमरा लोकनि केँ काठमांडू-केरुंग हाई-स्पीड रेल केर बारे मे तुरंत सोचबा लेल सीमित क' सकैत अछि, मुदा मानक गेज सिस्टम पर मध्यम गति सँ चलय बला पारंपरिक इलेक्ट्रिक ट्रेन फिलहाल संतोषजनक अछि.

रेलवे मास्टर प्लान

राष्ट्रिय स्वतंत्र पार्टी (आरएसपी) न॑ अपनऽ चुनावी घोषणापत्र म॑ ५० साल केरऽ रेलवे मास्टर प्लान तैयार करै के बात करलकै जेकरा म॑ पूर्व-पश्चिम रेलवे क॑ मानव आरू माल परिवहन लेली रीढ़ के हड्डी के रूप म॑ प्राथमिकता देलऽ गेलऽ छै आरू शाखा रेल नेटवर्क क॑ जे काठमांडू, पोखरा, दांग, सुर्खेत, आरू तराई केरऽ कई शहरऽ क॑ जोड़ै छै, आरू ओकरा स॑ भी आगू भारत आरू चीन क॑ जोड़ै के बात करलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

आइ गति मानव जीवनक अभिन्न अंग बनि गेल अछि । मेची स॑ महाकाली (९४५ किमी) तलक आबै लेली बुलेट ट्रेन म॑ आमतौर प॑ लगभग ३.१० घंटा लगै छै, जबकि पारंपरिक प्रकार के इलेक्ट्रिक ट्रेन म॑ ६ स॑ ९ घंटा लगै सकै छै । शायद, वर्तमान समय मे नेपाल के लेल ई एकटा महत्वाकांक्षी परियोजना बुझाइत अछि, एकर बजटीय बाधा के देखैत. मुदा शुरूए स सही प्रोजेक्ट चुनला स दीर्घकाल मे बेसी फायदा होएत। फिलहाल भविष्य मे हाई स्पीड अपग्रेड क्षमता वाला पारंपरिक इलेक्ट्रिक रेलवे गलियारा के डिजाइन करनाय सही विकल्प नहिं होयत किएक त’ परियोजना सुधार के लेल भारी राशि के अतिरिक्त पैसा के जरूरत होएत अछि.

सुरंग निर्माण, वक्र आ ज्यामिति कें रखरखाव, मजबूत पुल, अत्याधुनिक संकेत, 25 केवी विद्युतीकरण, जे-स्लैब ट्रैक प्रणाली, भविष्य कें अनुकूल स्टेशन आदि उच्च गति वाला रेल कें लेल किछ बुनियादी आवश्यकता छै. भारत केरऽ उत्तरी आरू पूर्वी शहरऽ केरऽ हाई स्पीड रेलवे गलियारा के साथ हमरऽ रेलवे केरऽ एकीकरण सांस्कृतिक आरू धार्मिक पर्यटन म॑ हमरऽ क्षमता क॑ दोहन करै म॑ अहम भूमिका निभाबै वाला होतै । आइ सीमा पार सँ निर्बाध आ सस्ती संपर्कक अभाव मे भारी संख्या मे भारतीय पर्यटक आसानी सँ नेपाल नहि जा सकैत छथि ।

मुदा नीक खबर ई अछि जे भारत अपन बुलेट ट्रेन नेटवर्क के हमरा सभ के नजदीक लाबय के योजना बना रहल अछि. दिल्ली-वाराणसी आ वाराणसी-सिलिगुड़ी मार्ग सर्वेक्षण आ योजनाक चरण मे अछि। काकरभिट्टा स॑ सिलीगुरी आरू अत्तरिया या महेंद्रनगर स॑ दिल्ली क॑ स्टैंडर्ड गेज बुलेट ट्रेन केरऽ पटरी स॑ जोड़ला स॑ अंततः हमरा सब क॑ भारतीय प्रमुख शहरऽ तलक पहुँच मिलतै ।

पूर्व-पश्चिम, काठमांडू-तराई, आ काठमांडू-पोखरा गलियारा औद्योगिक, पर्यटन, आ व्यापारिक गतिविधिक लेल नेपालक परिवहन संजालक प्रमुख धमनी अछि । हमर युवा तेजी स विकास लेल बेताब छथि। हुनकऽ आकांक्षा क॑ ध्यान म॑ रखतें हुअ॑ सरकार क॑ नेपाल केरऽ मुख्य परिवहन गलियारा म॑ हाई स्पीड रेल बुनियादी ढाँचा क॑ संशोधित करी क॑ लागू करै के चाही । मुदा, एकर मतलब ई नहिं जे हमरा लोकनिक सब शाखा गलियारा में एकहि तरहक सुविधा हो ; इलाका आरू भूगोल के आधार प॑ हम्मं॑ पारंपरिक या अर्ध-उच्च गति वाला इलेक्ट्रिक ट्रेन भी अपना सकै छियै ।

सरकार कए अपन पार्टी क 50 साल क रेलवे मास्टर प्लान क गहन विश्लेषण हेबाक चाही अगर हमरा सब कए क्षेत्रीय गतिशीलता क लेल गति आ सटीकता स तैयारी करबाक अछि। वैश्विक निर्यात लेली भारतीय रेलवे भी वंदे भारत केरऽ मानक गेज वेरिएंट के निर्माण करी रहलऽ छै, जेकरा स॑ ई एशिया, अफ्रीका आरू दक्षिण अमेरिका म॑ व्यापक रूप स॑ इस्तेमाल होय वाला ट्रैक गेज के साथ संगत होय जाय छै । लेकिन, ऐन्हऽ लगै छै कि हम्में अखनी तलक १३६ किलोमीटर के काठमांडू-रक्सुअल मार्ग लेली ब्रॉड गेज ट्रैक क॑ स्वीकार करै के स्थिति म॑ नै छियै, कैन्हेंकि ई परियोजना डीपीआर फाइनलाइजेशन के चरण म॑ आगू बढ़ी रहलऽ छै ।

समृद्धि के मार्ग

मल्टीपल गेज सिस्टम वाला देश निश्चित रूप स ओकर संचालन आ रखरखाव पर विभिन्न समस्या कए आमंत्रित करत। जँ से अछि तँ कोनो योजना वा लेट प्लानिंग गलत योजनासँ नीक नहि। सुरक्षा, तकनीकी, या कोनो अन्य कारण के पृष्ठभूमि में भारत आरू चीन क॑ दू अलग-अलग गेज सिस्टम स॑ जोड़ना सीधा तौर प॑ हमरऽ अपनऽ हित क॑ प्रभावित करै छै । निर्बाध आंतरिक कनेक्शन आ दूटा पैघ जनसंख्या गलियारा तक पहुंच हमर सबहक सर्वोच्च प्राथमिकता हेबाक चाही।

अतः हमरऽ रेलवे प्रणाली म॑ व्यापक रूप स॑ स्वीकृत तकनीक के साथ गति चुनना खाली समृद्धि के रास्ता प॑ ही पहुँची सकै छेलै । एहि नव एवेन्यू पर गिफ्ट प्रोजेक्ट स्वीकार करबाक बजाय हमरा लोकनि कें अपन ताकत के प्रदर्शन करबाक चाही जे हमरा सभक लेल आसान, सस्ता आ व्यावहारिक हो, नीक तकनीक के परिचय देल जाय. दस साल बाद चीन, जापान, आरू बहुत सारा यूरोपीय देश जैसनऽ देश अपनऽ बुलेट ट्रेन क॑ ५०० किमी/घंटा के रफ्तार स॑ गुड़काबै के स्थिति म॑ आबै वाला छै । अतः एक दशक के भीतर नेपाल के मुख्य परिवहन धमनियों में 300-320 किमी/घंटा सक्षम बुलेट ट्रेन गलियारा के दृष्टि रहना विकास से वंचित नेपाली लोग के लिए तार्किक एवं जायज है |

full_article:
By Sher Bahadur Sarki, Bajura, Aug. 3: Bajura remains one of Nepal’s least developed districts, ranking among the lowest in the Human Development Index. Poverty has remained largely unchanged for decades, forcing many locals to migrate to India in search of work simply to feed their families.

With few employment opportunities available in their villages, migration to India has become a way of life. However, while families leave in search of livelihoods, many of the houses they build back home are left unattended and gradually fall into disrepair.

Many families construct new homes by borrowing money from local lenders, but they seldom get the opportunity to live in them. Instead, they return to India to repay the loans, leaving the houses vacant for years.

As increasing numbers of people migrate abroad because of economic hardship, abandoned houses across the district are deteriorating and collapsing.

According to locals, many families first borrow money to build house and then move to India with their families to earn enough to repay the debt. As a result, the houses remain unoccupied and eventually become unsafe.

“I borrowed a few hundred thousand rupees several years ago to build my house,” said Surat Sarki of Budhiganga Municipality-10. “Before I could repay the loan, the house collapsed. Now my family has nowhere to live.”

“It is the rainy season and we no longer have a house to stay in. We cannot live outside, and I do not have the money to build another one,” he said.

Sarki appealed to the government to help arrange proper housing for families like his, saying such support would greatly ease their hardship.

Similar stories are common across Himali, Swamikartik Khapar, Jagannath, Budhinanda, Badimalika, Gaumul, Budhiganga, Triveni and Khaptad Chhededaha local levels, where many economically disadvantaged families have migrated for work.

Man Bahadur B.K of Budhinanda Municipality said poverty had forced many residents to leave their villages, resulting in abandoned and collapsing homes.

“When they are in the village, they borrow money to build a house,” he said. “Then they go back to India to repay the debt. Before they can clear the loan, the house they built begins to collapse.”

Most rural houses in Bajura are built with stone and mud and roofed with large slate slabs. Such traditional structures are particularly vulnerable to heavy rainfall and earthquakes.

According to the 2021 National Population and Housing Census, Bajura's nine local levels have a total of 24,443 houses.

Badimalika Municipality has 3,446 houses, Triveni Rural Municipality 3,350, Budhiganga Municipality 4,277, Budhinanda Municipality 3,452, Gaumul Rural Municipality 1,650, Himali Rural Municipality 1,722, Jagannath Rural Municipality 1,684, Swamikartik Khapar Rural Municipality 2,223 and Khaptad Chhededaha Rural Municipality 3,174.

Local authorities estimate that more than 2,000 houses across the district have now been damaged or destroyed by continuous rainfall.

Chief District Officer (CDO) Dorendra Niraula said persistent monsoon rains had caused extensive damage to settlements across Bajura.

“Previously, the District Disaster Management Committee had the authority to provide relief to families affected by floods, landslides and other disasters based on damage assessments submitted by local governments,” he said. “That authority no longer rests with the district administration.”

He explained that local governments now send detailed damage assessments to the relevant national reconstruction authority, which verifies the reports before approving reconstruction assistance for eligible households.
translated:
शेर बहादुर सरकी, बाजुरा, ३ अगस्त : बाजुरा नेपाल केरऽ सबसें कम विकसित जिला म॑ स॑ एक बनलऽ छै, जे मानव विकास सूचकांक म॑ सबसें कम स्थान प॑ छै । दशकों स॑ गरीबी बहुत हद तलक अपरिवर्तित रहलऽ छै, जेकरा चलतें बहुत सारा स्थानीय लोगऽ क॑ खाली अपनऽ परिवार केरऽ पेट भरना लेली काम के तलाश म॑ भारत पलायन करै ल॑ पड़ै छै ।

अपन गाम मे रोजगारक अवसर कम भेटबाक कारणे भारत मे पलायन जीवनक एकटा तरीका बनि गेल अछि । मुदा, परिवार जखन रोजी-रोटी के तलाश में निकलैत अछि, घर वापसी में जे घर बनबैत अछि, ओहि में सं बहुतो घर बेपसंद भ जाइत अछि आ धीरे-धीरे खराब भ जाइत अछि.

बहुतो परिवार स्थानीय उधारदाता सं उधार ल क नव घर बनबैत अछि, मुदा ओहि मे रहय के मौका शायदे कम मिलैत अछि. बल्कि कर्ज चुकाबय लेल भारत वापस आबि जाइत छथि, जाहि सं घर सालों तक खाली रहैत अछि.

आर्थिक तंगी के कारण बढ़ैत संख्या में लोक के विदेश पलायन भ रहल अछि, जिला भर में परित्यक्त घर खराब भ रहल अछि आ ढह रहल अछि.

स्थानीय लोकक अनुसार बहुतो परिवार पहिने घर बनेबा लेल उधार लैत अछि आ फेर अपन परिवारक संग भारत चलि जाइत अछि जाहि सं ओतेक कमाई कर्ज चुकाबय के अछि. एकरऽ परिणाम ई छै कि घर खाली रह॑ छै आरू अंततः असुरक्षित होय जाय छै ।

बुढीगंगा नगरपालिका-१० के सूरत सरकी कहलनि जे, हम कतेको साल पहिने किछु लाख रुपैया उधार ल कए अपन घर बनेने रही। “कर्ज चुकाबय सँ पहिने घर ढहि गेल, आब हमर परिवार केँ कतहु रहबाक जगह नहि अछि।”

ओ कहलनि जे, बरसात के मौसम अछि आ आब हमरा सब लग रहबाक लेल घर नहि अछि, बाहर नहि रहि सकैत छी, आ हमरा लग दोसर घर बनेबाक पाइ नहि अछि।

सरकी सरकार स अपील केलथि जे ओ हुनका सन परिवार क लेल उचित आवास क व्यवस्था मे मदद करथि आ कहलथि जे एहि तरहक सहयोग स हुनकर कठिनाई मे काफी कमी आबि जाएत।

हिमाली, स्वामी कार्तिक खापर, जगन्नाथ, बुधिनन्द, बदीमालिका, गौमूल, बुढ़ीगंगा, त्रिवेणी आ खप्ताद छेदेदहा स्थानीय स्तर पर सेहो एहने कथा आम अछि, जतय आर्थिक रूपेँ बहुत रास वंचित परिवार काजक लेल पलायन कएने अछि ।

बुधीनन्द नगरपालिकाके मानबहादुर बी.के, गरीबीके कारण बहुत रास निवासीके गाम छोड़ैके बाध्य रहलके कारण घर परित्यक्त आ ढहने बटैलै ।

ओ कहलनि जे, गाम मे रहला पर उधार ल क घर बनबैत छथि। “तखन कर्ज चुकाबय लेल भारत वापस चलि जाइत छथि, लोन क्लियर करबा सँ पहिने जे घर बनौने छलाह से ढहय लगैत छथि।”

बाजुराक अधिकांश ग्रामीण घर पाथर आ थालसँ बनल अछि आ छत पर पैघ-पैघ स्लेट स्लैब अछि । ऐहन पारंपरिक संरचना भारी वर्षा आ भूकंप कें विशेष रूप सं कमजोर छै.

2021 के राष्ट्रीय जनसंख्या आ आवास जनगणना के अनुसार बाजुरा के नौ स्थानीय स्तर पर कुल 24,443 घर अछि.

बडिमालिका नगरपालिका ३,४४६ मकान, त्रिवेणी गाउँपालिका ३,३५०, बुढीगंगा नगरपालिका ४,२७७, बुधिनन्द नगरपालिका ३,४५२, गौमुल गाउँपालिका १,६५०, हिमाली गाउँपालिका १,७२२, जगन्नाथ गाउँपालिका १,६८४, स्वामिकार्थिक खपार गाउँपालिका २,२२३ आ खप्तड छेदेदहा गाउँपालिका ३,१७४।

स्थानीय अधिकारी के अनुमान अछि जे जिला भरि मे आब लगातार बरखा सं दू हजार सं बेसि घर क्षतिग्रस्त या तबाह भ गेल अछि.

मुख्य जिल्ला अधिकारी (सीडीओ) डोरेन्द्र निरौला कहलनि जे, लगातार मानसून के वर्षा सं पूरा बाजुरा मे बस्ती के व्यापक नुकसान पहुंचल अछि।

ओ कहलनि जे, पहिने जिला आपदा प्रबंधन समिति के स्थानीय सरकार द्वारा प्रस्तुत क्षति आकलन के आधार पर बाढ़, भूस्खलन आ अन्य आपदा सं प्रभावित परिवार के राहत देबाक अधिकार छल। “ओ अधिकार आब जिला प्रशासन पर नहि अछि।”

हुनी बतैलकै कि स्थानीय सरकार अब॑ संबंधित राष्ट्रीय पुनर्निर्माण प्राधिकरण क॑ विस्तृत नुकसान के आकलन भेजै छै, जे पात्र घरऽ लेली पुनर्निर्माण सहायता क॑ मंजूरी दै स॑ पहल॑ रिपोर्ट के सत्यापन करै छै ।
